verdict.rationale: Bruno's pre-request and post-response JavaScript hooks run automatically around request events, can be set at request, folder, or collection level, and support request chaining. Collection runs can also be wired into CI/CD pipelines, but the trigger then comes from the external pipeline, not from Bruno. There is no evidence of a general rules engine or event-driven automation beyond the request lifecycle. Missing for 10: declarative rule definitions, triggers on events beyond request execution (webhooks, schedules, file or API changes), a native automation or workflow builder, and independent corroboration.
